entries.prompt: Perform ONLY a framing/padding correction on this ONE isolated Clan Leader mask. Preserve the existing mask exactly: same camera, shape, horn lengths/curvatures, layer count, red eyes, black-green gunmetal paint, silver complex respirator and all source-visible worn details. Do not re-sculpt, symmetrize, recolor or repaint it. Reduce the complete mask including its horns uniformly to88% of its current size, recenter on an otherwise unchanged transparent canvas and keep the source canvas aspect ratio. The complete mask should occupy about78% of canvas HEIGHT, with roughly11% clear transparent space above the highest horn tip and below the chin, and generous left/right space. Keep both horn tips and chin fully visible. No flesh, dreads, torso, background, text, new crest, new red panel, extra parts or new surface marks. True transparent background, no floor/shadow or border. Return exactly one complete isolated native PNG, not multiple views.
entries.sourceGenerationPrompt: Create exactly ONE isolated removable biomask faithful to the actual NECA Deluxe Clan Leader sculpture and paint photographed in the attached Toy Fair2016 official catalog image. VERSION A is a source-faithful isolated reconstruction of that licensed toy edition, not a film prop and not a redesigned fantasy helmet. The only mask reference is the WORN MASK on the MAIN FULL FIGURE at left/center of this image; all THREE right-side head insets are UNMASKED organic heads and MUST NOT supply mask geometry. Use the same nearly frontal camera as the worn main mask, with its slightly downward face tilt. Identify and copy the existing dark green-black gunmetal shell and its tiered swept forehead plates, the TWO very long narrow upward curving horns that grow from its upper left and upper right corners, the source red narrow V-angled eye lenses, dark angular cheek frames and complex silver-gray ribbed industrial respirator/muzzle. Precisely preserve the horn lengths/curvatures/spacing, layered forehead outline, nasal planes, round cheek/filter recesses and the existing arrangement of silver vertical curved ribs and dark slots across the closed lower face. Do not infer designs from the name Clan Leader. The dark oxidized green-gunmetal and worn silver paint of this photograph are the palette authority, with small red EYE lenses only, not a gold/brass redesign or glowing neon LEDs. Preserve modest source-visible toy paint wear, not invented glyphs or over-detailed microtexture. Remove the entire wearer and all surrounding objects: NO white dreadlocks, NO orange skin or organic head/teeth/mandibles, NO neck, NO collar or necklace/skulls, NO shoulder armor/caster, NO body, NO cloth and NO weapon. Exclude the exposed reddish organic crown behind/above the shell; do not turn it into a fabricated red screen or extra armor crest. Preserve only the actual continuous metal mask and its proven horns/attached respirator. Do not invent unseen rear surfaces, extra spikes/horns, screws, symbols, wires, filters or teeth. Render the source-faithful isolated sculpt with neutral product-photo light and its existing matte/worn toy-metal paint character; not polished all-chrome or an epic redesign. Use a square transparent canvas with VERY GENEROUS negative-space padding: the complete horn-tip-to-muzzle-tip object is about960pixels high on a1280pixel canvas, no greater than78% of canvas height, centered; at least10 to12% true clear transparent margin above highest horn and below chin. Preserve whole tips, no clipping. One complete mask only, true transparent background, no contact sheet, no body, no text, no logo, no frame, no floor/shadow/vignette.

entries.sourceGenerationPrompt: Create ONE version B PHG-quality realtime PBR game-art rendition of the FIRST attached isolated Clan Leader mask, preserving its exact silhouette, proportions, nearly frontal camera, source angle, TWO long curving horns, tiered forehead plates, narrow red V-angle eye lenses, dark cheek frames, circular side filter recesses and complex silver ribbed industrial respirator. The second official Toy Fair2016 photograph establishes the original NECA sculpture/paint, using only its MAIN FIGURE WORN MASK; its three organic unmasked head insets are not mask geometry. Preserve the same dark green-black gunmetal shell, subdued source green oxidation, restrained silver-gray lower ribs and red EYE lenses. Absolutely no new gold, glyphs, spikes, extra horns, tusks, nose vent, lower-face additions or red top screen. Keep the exact mask position and scale from version A and the same landscape canvas aspect ratio, with complete horn tips and at least9-11% clear padding above/below. Upgrade rendering only: neutral upper-left/front key light, soft frontal fill, coherent fine PBR metallic material, readable sculpt planes and restrained roughness/wear. Reduce the excessive coarse crackled grain in A into controlled subtle metal microtexture; do not turn that grain into ornamental engravings. Keep the existing source-visible mechanical ridges/recesses distinct, not melted or smoothed away. No polished chrome everywhere, no intense glossy speckles, no bloom or glowing eye spill. Wearer stays excluded: no flesh, organic crest, teeth, mandibles, white dreadlocks, collar, armor/shoulders/caster, necklace, body or weapon. No invented back surfaces. One isolated native transparent PNG mask only, no text, border, logo, floor shadow, vignette or other background.
